explanation: Lines of equal air pressure are isobars and lines of equal temperature are isotherms. Where contour lines bunch close together, the slope is steep.

claims.text: Contour lines on a map join points of equal height above sea level.
Lines joining points of equal rainfall, air pressure or temperature are isohyets, isobars and isotherms.
Lines of equal air pressure are called isobars, and lines of equal temperature are called isotherms.
Closely spaced contour lines show a steep slope.
